fact: The document gives the RGPH-5 census as November 2022 and reports a resident population of 8,095,498 counted.
INSEED published the definitive results of RGPH-5 (November 2022) by region, prefecture, sex and urban/rural, totalling 8,095,498 residents.

The document cites results of the 5th general population and housing census (RGPH-5) as showing 141,757 children aged 9-14 out of formal school; it gives no enumeration date, so the document's publication date is used.
